environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no request inspection. The service is exposed on port 8080 with direct TCP passthrough. No API Gateway or WAF in front. Clients connect directly and can supply arbitrary headers including X-Forwarded-Host with any value. The UPSTREAM_API_URL points to a real provider API endpoint.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no header inspection)
